# A-1 Drain Cleaning

> A-1 Drain Cleaning provides drain cleaning and sewer service from Mason City, Iowa. The business serves Mason City and its listed surrounding communities, with additional service in Albert Lea, Minnesota. 24/7 service is offered; call to confirm current availability.

## Service distinctions

Each item below is a distinct service. Bathroom Drain Cleaning covers bathroom sink, shower, and bathtub drains; kitchen, roof, storm, and yard drains remain separate services.

- Floor Drain Cleaning — separate from basement drain cleaning; a backup is a symptom, not the service name.
- Basement Drain Cleaning.
- Garage Drain Cleaning.
- Utility Sink Drain Cleaning.

- Bathroom Drain Cleaning — covers bathroom sink, shower, and bathtub drain cleaning; separate from kitchen drains.
- Main Drain Cleaning.
- Sewer Line Cleaning.

- Smoke Testing.
- Drain & Sewer Camera Inspections and Sewer Line Locating are separate services.

## Drain and sewer guidance

A floor drain backup does not always mean the floor drain itself is blocked. The restriction can be farther down a branch drain, shared drain line, or main sewer line.

A washing machine sends a large amount of water into the drain line quickly. If a floor drain rises when the washer drains, the washer may be exposing a restriction farther downstream.

Homes without basements can show a main-line backup differently. Wastewater may rise into a bathtub or shower instead of a basement floor drain.

## Service-area directory

The directory groups listed communities under eight Iowa counties: Cerro Gordo, Floyd, Franklin, Hancock, Mitchell, Winnebago, Worth, and Butler. The nine dedicated Iowa city pages are Mason City, Clear Lake, Charles City, Forest City, Garner, Hampton, Nora Springs, Northwood, and Rockwell. Albert Lea, Minnesota, is also included. County groups are directory references, not county landing pages; call to confirm availability for a specific address.
